verification_report.summary: Sequential verification found one critical scope error and one internal-reference gap. The remaining checked arguments and identities passed, including the closed Bott–Chern loci, zero-class Hopf obstruction, Lee-curvature signs, twisted gauge formulas, balanced obstruction, same-metric rigidity hypotheses and Lee–Gauduchon pairing. Primary-source hypotheses were checked; no bounded mass property or unpublished VX theorem was assumed. The conjectures and Question 47.56 remain unresolved.

critical_errors.location: thm:lck-vaisman-volume and the following symmetry paragraph
critical_errors.issue: The chapter defines Vaisman metrics by parallel Lee form and allows lambda=0. Consequently its volume-uniqueness theorem includes Kähler metrics and is false. On X=C^n/(Z+iZ)^n, n>=2, the flat forms omega_t=(i/2)(t dz_1∧dbar z_1+t^(-1) dz_2∧dbar z_2+sum_{j=3}^n dz_j∧dbar z_j), t>0, are distinct Kähler metrics with zero Lee class and identical pointwise volume. The invariance and total-volume hypotheses are automatic. The primary Vaisman theorem uses the nonzero-Lee setting of its canonical foliation. The following contraction-to-transverse-volume argument also requires nonzero Lee form. See [primary Theorem 4.1 and its canonical-foliation setup](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.08808v2).

gaps.issue: The prescribed-volume Gauduchon theorem is attributed to chap:gauduchon-variational-volume, but that chapter and its included sections give the variational formula for scalar Hermitian Monge–Ampère normalization, not the asserted Gauduchon prescribed-volume existence theorem. The relevant result is thm:stw-volume in chapter_smooth_equations.tex (Székelyhidi–Tosatti–Weinkove, Theorem 1.4). The stated limitation concerning LCK structure and twisted classes is correct for that theorem, but its current internal reference is misdirected. See [STW Theorem 1.4](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1503.04491).

repair_hints: Require a nonzero Lee form in thm:lck-vaisman-volume and its canonical-foliation discussion, or explicitly restrict the definition of Vaisman to strictly LCK metrics. If retaining the Kähler case, also fix a Kähler class. Replace the misdirected Gauduchon chapter citation with a direct reference to thm:stw-volume in chapter_smooth_equations.tex.
